args.description: A single hairline diagonal slash of pale bluegray pixels, very long and thin, tapered. Upperleft to lowerright slope nearly vertical. Exactly one narrow streak on transparent empty canvas. Minimal pixel particle. No cloud, no objects, no rounded droplet.

ONE long thin silverblue motion streak, slender needle shape from upper left to lower right nearly vertical. Narrow dim tail and tiny bright lower tip, 2pixels thick at most. Empty transparent canvas around the isolated slash. Crisp minimalist pixel particle, no cloud, no objects, no rounded waterdrop.

A tiny low fork-shaped liquid splash, three separate short pale bluegray pixel strokes spring upward from a short horizontal contact dash. Very flat and delicate silhouette, only4pixels tall and10pixels wide, centered. Transparent canvas. No circle, no bubble, no orb, no vessel, no scenery.
